display.tagline: Queue source URLs; get clean, tagged knowledge notes in your research workspace and an email digest.
display.description: A source-processing workflow agent. The operator queues blog, Twitter/X, Reddit, and article URLs; on each run the agent fetches every queued source, extracts the meaty article (filler stripped, not a summary), writes it as a tagged Markdown note into the shared tr-research workspace, emails the operator the full note, and reports run statistics. One bad source never aborts the run.
capabilities: Drains a queue of source URLs end-to-end on each run
Fetches blogs, articles, Twitter/X threads, and Reddit threads (web fetch + browser fallback)
Extracts the full substantive article with filler removed — not a summary
Writes tagged Markdown notes with frontmatter into the tr-research workspace
Emails the operator each finished note and reports per-run statistics

workspaceBindings.name: research
workspaceBindings.purpose: The tr-research knowledge base this agent produces into — each processed source becomes a tagged Markdown note here for the whole team to read and search.
